import Mathlib

def Tiende (a : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ) : Prop :=
  ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, |a n - L| < ε

example : Tiende (fun _ => 5) 5 := by
  intro ε hε
  use 0
  intro n hn
  simp
  exact hε
